walkthrough:
Combine the fractions over a common denominator and equate the numerator to zero:
$$(\cos\theta - 4)(5\cos\theta - 2) - 4\sin^2\theta = 0$$

Expand the first product and substitute $\sin^2\theta = 1 - \cos^2\theta$:
$$5\cos^2\theta - 2\cos\theta - 20\cos\theta + 8 - 4(1 - \cos^2\theta) = 0$$
$$5\cos^2\theta - 22\cos\theta + 8 - 4 + 4\cos^2\theta = 0$$

Collect like terms to obtain the required quadratic in $\cos\theta$:
$$9\cos^2\theta - 22\cos\theta + 4 = 0$$

Solve the quadratic equation $9\cos^2\theta - 22\cos\theta + 4 = 0$ using the quadratic formula:
$$\cos\theta = \frac{22 \pm \sqrt{(-22)^2 - 4(9)(4)}}{2(9)} = \frac{22 \pm \sqrt{340}}{18}$$
$$\cos\theta = 2.247 \quad (\text{reject since } |\cos\theta| \le 1) \quad \text{or} \quad \cos\theta \approx 0.1978$$

Find the first quadrant solution for $\theta$:
$$\theta_1 = \cos^{-1}(0.1978) \approx 78.59^\circ \approx 78.6^\circ$$

Find the fourth quadrant solution within $[0^\circ, 360^\circ]$:
$$\theta_2 = 360^\circ - 78.59^\circ = 281.41^\circ \approx 281.4^\circ$$
$$\text{Solutions: } \theta = 78.6^\circ, \quad 281.4^\circ$$
